text: The paper reports that only MetaMath-trained generators show noticeable easy-to-hard gaps (e.g. 16.6 vs 14.2 for MetaMath-7b-ICL), while gaps for PRM800K-trained models are below 1% or even inverted for ICL, which the authors attribute to lower-quality PRM800K data teaching only task format. The strongest generator is full SFT on MetaMath (35.4), up to 3.2 points above its easy-to-hard SFT counterpart (32.2).
title: Easy-to-hard SFT of generators trails full SFT; gap depends on SFT data quality
